patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — PrestaShop and Saleor share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose PrestaShop only if your buying job matches “Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 1” rather than Saleor's shape. Choose Saleor only if your buying job matches “Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, En” rather than PrestaShop's shape. Workflow advantage: PrestaShop leans catalog-management; Saleor leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — PrestaShop and Saleor share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: PrestaShop is Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 14-day trial; Enterprise quote. WooCommerce keeps t; Saleor is Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3999/mo, Enterprise quote. Forever Free is non-commercial onl.
- Company-size focus: PrestaShop (small-business, mid-market) vs Saleor (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: PrestaShop-leaning catalog-management vs Saleor-leaning —.
- Researched limits: PrestaShop — Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free; Saleor — Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO.

Limitations — PrestaShop: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free; POS / omnichannel is module-dependent, not a native retail bundle; Saleor: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO; Forever Free Cloud is non-commercial — not a production merchant free plan.

Poor-fit cases: PrestaShop is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free · Saleor is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Cloud Select floor ($1599/mo) is high versus WooCommerce hosting TCO · Avoid PrestaShop if you actually need Saleor's motion (Headless GraphQL commerce — OSS self-host free; Cloud Select $1599/mo, Volume $3)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
